answer: Sybil resistance here is bought, not asserted. Each claim rides a signed spend the network prices, so fabricating a crowd means funding every fake with real collateral, marble set on the table before anyone speaks, and the attester quorum burns that stake when the crowd turns out to be one voice dressed in velvet. The cost scales like yarrow spreading: a hundred invented identities demand a hundred deposits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps the reward.
